cases.name: D104: an L4 run with no approval marker: the deny sends to /team-run, an unpriced line is refused, the estimate it submits is recorded, the run gate then allows
D104: an L4 run whose marker is invalid: the deny sends to /team-run to price again, the line it submits rewrites the marker, the run gate then allows
D104: an L3 run made remote by a hosted decision block: estimate --level L3 prices its decision calls (from the L2 runs), the submitted line is recorded, the run gate then allows

D104: an L3 run made remote by a provider active but undeclared: the estimate refuses and names /team-decision, an unpriced line is refused; declared with a price, the submitted line is recorded and the run gate allows
D104: decide --allow-remote: the deny sends to /team-run and --decide, estimate --decide prices the calls, the submitted line is recorded, the run gate then allows the decide
